entities.name: Viroscek
entities.description: Blighted land in the far provinces of Cyristiii, 'The Place of the Damned'; once called Woerishin.

entities.name: Cyristiii
entities.description: Land or plane in whose far provinces Viroscek lies; unclear if it is a plane.

entities.name: Xavis
entities.description: Figure whose opponent died centuries before Viroscek became almost peaceful.

relations.quote: Viroscek is a land in the far reaches of Cyristiii
